question: On which side must the mudrā called muṇḍamudrā be displayed?
premises: The mudrā is to be shown.
Its designated placement is the right side.
inference: The muṇḍamudrā is to be displayed on the right side.
plain_english: One should display this mudrā on the right side; it is called the Muṇḍa-mudrā.
